heroHeadline: Day 665: Ex-INE Chief Córdova Reveals Inzunza's Sister Validated Rocha Moya's 2021 Election in 4.5 Minutes; WSJ: 3,000+ Dead in Sinaloa Cartel War
heroSubtitle: 665 days of cartel civil war — May 19: Former INE president Lorenzo Córdova publicly contradicted Sheinbaum's claim of no election irregularities: the INE documented armed Sinaloa Cartel members at polling stations, 23 vandalized booths, 51 missing electoral packages, and burned ballots in 2021 — but validation was the Sinaloa State Electoral Tribunal's responsibility. Explosive detail: the sister of Senator Inzunza Cazárez (third SDNY-indicted official to surrender, San Diego, May 17) was the tribunal magistrate who validated Rocha Moya's victory in just 4.5 minutes. WSJ investigation (May 17) reports 3,000+ dead and 3,600+ missing since September 2024 — with Chapitos described as near collapse. Extradition standoff enters Day 20: three of ten SDNY-indicted officials (Mérida Sánchez, Díaz Vega, Inzunza Cazárez) in Brooklyn MDC; seven including Rocha Moya and Mayor Gámez Mendívil remain in Mexico. El Mayo sentencing before EDNY Judge Cogan set July 20, 2026; La Mayiza ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops in Sinaloa; NGO Sabuesos Unidas: ~5,800 disappearances since Sep 2024.
